records.title: 10-K
records.text: Revenue was flat in 2025 primarily due to increased base yields at both of our transportation segments and higher volume at Federal Express, which offset two fewer operating days at both of our transportation segments, lower shipments and fuel surcharges at FedEx Freight, and unfavorable currency exchange rates.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Consequently, this environment has led to lower shipments at FedEx Freight, negatively affecting our results in 2025.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Partially offsetting these pressures were continued savings related to DRIVE and higher demand for international economy and U.S. ground package services.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Lower fuel prices negatively affected yields through lower fuel surcharges at FedEx Freight and reduced fuel expense at both of our transportation segments during 2025.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Operating income declined in 2025 primarily due to lower shipments and fuel surcharges at FedEx Freight, a continued mix shift toward deferred package services which constrained yield growth, and the expiration of our contract with the U.S. Postal Service ("USPS").
